tests.name: external config change requires runtime refresh
empty enabledModels disables the imported model

findings.evidence: MyBuddy getMyBuddyDir always uses homedir/.mybuddy; Magpie adapter honors PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR
findings.change: Make MyBuddy adapter use the actual product root, independently from Pi

findings.issue: External models configuration is not automatically recomposed
findings.evidence: Packaged Electron listModels omitted new provider until agent.reloadModels(magpie)
findings.change: Local runtime reload plus renderer catalog/default synchronization

findings.evidence: Existing task model stayed fixture/memory-fixture after external default changed
findings.change: Default changes affect new tasks; existing tasks use explicit user selection

findings.evidence: Magpie piScope treats [] like absence; actual MyBuddy returned enabled:false
findings.change: On explicit connection add the selected model even when list is empty

findings.evidence: Actual app read modelThinkingLevels low with defaultThinkingLevel high; applySessionReasoningPreference prefers per-model
findings.change: Read/write thinking preference of selected model

findings.evidence: Adapter writes Pi block with common token and no User-Agent override; live usage contains pi calls
findings.change: Use gateway.TokenFor(mybuddy) or scoped provider User-Agent; validate classification on real requests

findings.issue: Native desktop catalog discovery differs from CLI
findings.evidence: piLike uses piRegistry(id), which scans CLI npm paths; MyBuddy has no CLI
findings.change: Use MyBuddy exported catalog or models.json for native model choices; do not assume a CLI registry

scope: Read-only diagnosis of user configuration and live DB; isolated fixture profile for desktop verification; no live configuration or production source changed
